experiments.why: A path with no dynamic params, where the caller gets undefined params, must come back unchanged.
A plain param followed by a {+rest} catch-all must be rewritten to /planets/{id}/{rest}.

source.quote: returns paths without dynamic params unchanged

obligations.statement: toOpenAPIPath returns a path without dynamic params unchanged, e.g. '/planets' stays '/planets'.
toOpenAPIPath rewrites dynamic params to plain OpenAPI form, including the {+param} form, so '/planets/{id}/{+rest}' becomes '/planets/{id}/{rest}'.

source.quote: does nothing for unconstrained inputs without dynamic params

obligations.statement: When the input schema is missing or accepts anything and the path has no dynamic params, buildRequest leaves the operation as an empty object.

source.quote: maps compact inputs to a request body

obligations.statement: For a compact object input with no dynamic path params on a body-carrying method, buildRequest documents the input as the operation's request body.

source.quote: omits required for optional compact request bodies

obligations.statement: When the compact input schema is optional, buildRequest emits a request body without required: true.

source.quote: maps compact path params and keeps the remaining fields in the body

obligations.statement: For path '/planets/{id}' and a compact object input that has id plus other fields, buildRequest documents id as a path parameter and keeps only the remaining fields in the request body.

source.quote: applies params styles to path parameters

obligations.statement: For a path with several dynamic params such as '/planets/{id}/{tags}/{filters}', buildRequest documents each as a path parameter with its requested params style applied.

source.quote: marks the request body optional when every non-param field is optional

obligations.statement: When every input field other than the path params is optional, buildRequest marks the request body as not required.

source.quote: maps compact GET inputs to query parameters and applies every query style

obligations.statement: For a GET procedure, buildRequest documents a compact object input as query parameters with each query style applied, not as a request body.

source.quote: maps HEAD inputs to query parameters like GET

obligations.statement: For a HEAD procedure, buildRequest documents input fields that are not path params as query parameters, the same way it does for GET.
